doc.summary: quantum_visualizer.py - Production Quantum State Visualizer ============================================================ Brutal real-time visualization of quantum state evolution using trained neural network backends (Hamiltonian, Schrodinger, Dirac).
doc.description:
Imports and uses existing quantum_computer.py, molecular_sim.py,
and advanced_experiments.py infrastructure.

Author: Gris Iscomeback
License: AGPL v3
